title: ‘The Pitt’ Boss Says Noah Wyle’s Season 2 Storyline “Shows What Can Happen If You Don’t Take the Time to Resolve Mental Health Issues”
summary: Sepideh Moafi talks about what the future holds for her character as she continues to deal with her recently revealed condition as Shawn Hatosy reveals how Dr. Abbot feels about Supriya Ganesh's Dr. Mohan leaving and showrunner Scott Gemmill shares why the series shaking up its cast, "eliminates the false jeopardy that a lot of shows might have."
